sentence_stem: Not only did the results exceed our expectations,
correct_completion: but the budget also came in under the planned limit.
full_sentence: Not only did the results exceed our expectations, but the budget also came in under the planned limit.
acceptable_variants: and the budget was also below the planned limit.
but the budget came in under the planned limit too.

options.text: and the budget came in under the planned limit.
options.why_wrong: 'And' does not create the emphatic two-part structure that 'not only ... but also' requires.

options.text: the budget also came in under the planned limit.
options.why_wrong: After an inverted 'Not only did', the second clause needs the linker 'but' to complete the structure.

options.text: but the budget also came in under the planned limit.
however the budget was under the planned limit.
options.why_wrong: 'However' cannot complete the 'not only ... but also' pattern started by the stem.

grammar_focus: Fronted negative adverbial 'Not only' with subject-auxiliary inversion and 'but also' in the second clause
explanation: 'Not only' at the start of a clause triggers inversion of the auxiliary verb, and the second half of the structure is introduced by 'but also'. Learners whose first language is Russian often omit the linker because Russian can join clauses with simple juxtaposition, so the second half must be marked explicitly in English.
translation: Не только результаты превзошли наши ожидания, но и бюджет оказался ниже запланированного лимита.
